about_short_description.short_description: Rational specializes in industrial-grade cooking products for commercial kitchens with a range of cooking centres and combi steamers.

product.name: iCombi Pro
product.description: A combi steamer that combines steam and hot air cooking for various applications in professional kitchens.

product.name: iVario Pro
product.description: A multifunctional cooking system that replaces several traditional kitchen appliances for large-scale cooking.

product.name: iCombi Classic
product.description: A combi steamer with precise steam and hot air control for experienced chefs in professional kitchens.

product.name: ConnectedCooking
product.description: A digital kitchen management platform for remote control and monitoring of cooking devices.

product.name: Digital Products
product.description: Software upgrades based on AI and data analytics to enhance kitchen productivity and management.

product.name: RATIONAL ServicePlus
product.description: A service program providing support, training, and maintenance for RATIONAL cooking systems.
